hud.status-pill.data: seed 1 stone town: date, population, food, coin

hud.season-strip-panel.data: the town's year strip with its marks and the food line

hud.time-cluster.data: the speed seals and the settings button

hud.settings-popover.data: autoplay, tutorial, audio, save and render switches

hud.layer-switch.data: the three layers, two locked (tutorial on)

hud.action-dock.data: build, ledger, steward (undo when a site is new)

hud.steward-bubble.data: the steward's line (quiet, or the advisor's line when he speaks)

hud.crisis-icons.data: the famine's alerts (at most three bells)

hud.stuck-goods.data: the 1404 manor's worst stuck pile (a kit secondary button left of the bells)

hud.goal-help.data: a tutorial goal card's help line
hud.goal-help.unreachable: the help seal shows only on a tutorial card whose step has an advisor line; the opening card, the one after it and the chapter goal cards (tutorial off) carry none, and later steps need buildings finished (UI-AUDIT-1 smoke runs)

hud.unlock-banner.unreachable: shows only when a tutorial step unlocks a tool; no scripted path completes one (survey §2: no browser script reaches it)

hud.pause-veil.data: the paused town's badge (speed 0, no modal)

hud.completion-toast.data: the carter town's mill site finishing at speed 3

hud.era-ceremony.unreachable: shows only on the tick an era is entered; no cached state sits on that tick (survey §2: static contrast check only)

hud.zone-toolbar.data: the zone layer's kinds and tools

hud.prediction-chip.data: a living tool's placement chip over open ground

hud.hover-tooltip.data: a hungry house's cause tooltip (hover, no tool)

hud.build-drawer.fen.data: the fen's trade cards with the drain tool

hud.prediction-chip.drain.data: the drain tool's lines over a mere (cells, timber, men, seasons)

hud.build-details.unreachable: the HUD's build drawer is controlled, which hides the details' toggle (BuildMenu.tsx: `open !== undefined`); nothing opens it in play

slot.goals.data: the goal log, the settlement line and its progress

slot.goals.drawer.data: the goal log inside the slot

slot.population.panel.data: the population log inside the slot

slot.population.records.data: the famine town's population records after it ran (QA-028: the records, not a 22 px band)

slot.ledger.steward.data: the stone town's stocks with the steward's advice open

hud.steward-bubble.ledger.data: the steward's open advice beside the ledger

slot.ledger.steward-concern.data: the famine's alerts with the steward's warning open

slot.ledger.rights.data: chapter 4's rights register (charter rights, fee farm, revolt pressure)

slot.ledger.rights-decline.data: chapter 2's register after a right is lost

slot.ledger.wage.data: chapter 3's wage ledger under the stocks

map.selection.farmstead.data: a farmstead and its crop choice

modal.pause.data: the pause menu and its settings

modal.petition.heir.data: the heir's card with three candidates

modal.chapter-loading.data: the new game's loading screen (900 ms)

modal.person-card.data: a house member's card (one wearing a state ornament when the house has one)

modal.history.records.data: the stone town's chronicle: timeline, filters, record list, detail

modal.history.snapshot-figure.data: the then-map with its caption (the caption measured beside the framed box)

modal.history.biography.king.data: the king's biography: the empty-records line

modal.history.factions.data: chapter 4's factions: influence, tug of war, relations

modal.legacy-ending.data: the campaign's legacy verdict and ending

modal.chronicle-book.data: the chronicle book's title page and contents

screen.welcome.data: a fresh profile's title parchment and mode buttons

dev.ui-kit.tooltip.data: the kit Tooltip in the gallery

dev.ui-kit.number.data: the kit NumberField's states in the gallery

modal.lord.home-petition.data: the boundary dispute (Wave 44 01), both answers' numbers

modal.lord.home-petition.guardian.data: a minor lord's wardship petition (the court line with his guardian)

map.selection.lord-farmstead.data: the lord's slice: a town-built farmstead's card with its why-here button

lord.receipt.data: a town-built farmstead's receipt: five reasons, the next best site, the chance, the 10d subsidy and its decisions

lord.receipt-old.data: the same receipt from a save before the chance was kept

lord.receipt-none.data: the opening well: no receipt, the reason instead of an empty frame

lord.receipt-inspector.data: the first store's receipt (or why it has none) from the left inspector

slot.ledger.lord.data: the lord tab: the four policies (stability), the 10d farmstead subsidy, the draft and the dues at 80%

slot.ledger.lord-refusal.data: a subsidy draft past a quarter of the treasury: the reason written, the set button shut

hud.food-breakdown.data: the town's food split five ways, the ledger and close buttons

hud.command-pins.data: the lord's public work (the keep, locked until the fortified town) and encouragement-zone pins
